t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The pairs of gnomes are always the same, they will never give more than 9 mushrooms, and there is a pattern to their appearances instead of being random

vb_textbox.text: The maximum number of mushrooms you can get is 9 for 1x and 45 for 5x so when you find a gnome that gives that amount you should remember it. They appear in the same pairs each time, but sometimes on different sides.
